mapper.update: update CREDIT_LINES x set HAP_CREDIT_AMT = (select case when (x.HAP_CREDIT_AMT - a.TRADE_AMT) > 0 then nvl(x.HAP_CREDIT_AMT, 0) - nvl(a.TRADE_AMT, 0) else 0 end atm from (select SEQNO, sum(TRADE_AMT) TRADE_AMT, max(VAL_DATE) from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION where PTL_ID = #{ptlid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by SEQNO) a where x.seqno = a.seqno) where exists (select 1 from (select SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION where PTL_ID = #{ptlid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by SEQNO) a where x.seqno = a.seqno)

SELECT A.VALUATION FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION A, FIN_PRODUCT C
C.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND C.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND C.FINPROD_TYPE2 = A.FINPROD_TYPE2 AND A.VAL_DATE = (SELECT MAX(VAL_DATE) FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION A2 WHERE A2.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND A2.VAL_DATE <= #{sysDate})

select FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, BRANCH BRANCH, TYPE_1 TYPE_1, TYPE_2 TYPE_2, TYPE_3 TYPE_3, TYPE_4 TYPE_4, TYPE_5 TYPE_5, TYPE_6 TYPE_6, TYPE_7 TYPE_7, TYPE_8 TYPE_8, TYPE_9 TYPE_9, TYPE_10 TYPE_10, TYPE_11 TYPE_11, TYPE_12 TYPE_12 from FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and BRANCH = #{branch,jdbcType=DECIMAL}

SELECT B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID bondCode, B.FINPROD_ABBR bondAbbrName, A.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE * A.PLEDGE_NUMBER pledgePrin, A.PLEDGE_RATIO*100 pledgeRatio, A.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID finprodId FROM FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
